name: window-management
title: Window Management
description: Move and resize the focused window, or any window, from the keyboard: halves, thirds, quarters, maximize, center, resize to a size, nudge, fullscreen, the next display, and back to where it was.
author: pal

settings.label: Gap
settings.description: Pixels between a window and the screen edge, and between two windows of a split.

settings.label: Almost Maximize
settings.description: How much of the screen Almost Maximize fills, centred.

settings.label: Reasonable Size
settings.description: How much of the screen Reasonable Size fills, centred.

settings.label: Move step
settings.description: Pixels Move Left, Right, Up and Down nudge the window by.

settings.label: Cycle on repeat
settings.text: A half applied again steps to two thirds, then a third, then the half (left and right families), as Rectangle does

store.tagline: Snap, resize and move any window from the keyboard
features: 32 layouts: halves, thirds, quarters, maximize, center, larger, smaller, move, next display, fullscreen, minimize
Acts on the window you were in; `cmd+enter` picks another window first
Restore puts a window back where it was before a run of layouts
Resize to a size typed in the search bar (`1280x720`), keeping the window centred
A gap between windows and a nudge step to set; with `cycle` on, Left Half again steps through two thirds and a third
Global hotkeys per layout move the focused window without opening the panel

screenshots.caption: Every layout with its diagram; Enter applies it to the focused window
Typing narrows the list: quarter leaves the four corners
Arrange Window picks the window first, from every one open, then the layout for it
The layouts again, the picked window named under each
Moves by a step, the next display, fullscreen, minimize, unminimize and restore, each with its diagram
Resize to… is a form: a size in pixels and, if you like, a place; left blank the window stays centred where it is

actions.title: Apply
actions.description: The layout on the focused window.

actions.title: Apply to…
actions.description: Pick a window from the open ones, then the layout goes on that one.

actions.title: Resize
actions.description: On Resize to…: the bar takes the size (required) and X, Y (optional); the size (and place) typed goes on the window and the HUD says the size.

actions.title: Arrange
actions.description: In Arrange Window: the layouts for the picked window.

layout.description: Move the focused window to a layout

name.description: left_half, right_half, maximize, larger, move_left, fullscreen, minimize, next_display, restore, ... (the row ids; Resize to… takes its size in the bar, not from a link)

window-management.title: Window Management
window-management.description: One row per layout; Enter applies it to the window you were in.

keys.title: Apply to a window you pick

arrange.title: Arrange Window
arrange.description: Pick a window first, then the layout.
